Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 1
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly identified the major process of surface rock formation on volcanoes. While it is true that intrusive igneous rocks form from slow cooling deep underground (Option C), the question specifically asks about "surface rock formation on volcanoes." Volcanic rocks (extrusive igneous rocks) are formed when melted rock (magma) reaches the surface and cools rapidly (Option A). The Planner confused the general process of igneous rock formation with the specific surface context provided in the question, leading to the wrong answer.
